review_method: Manual conservative static review of all 88 pinned titles, PR bodies, resolved issue descriptions, source patch hunks/path scope and dataset phase test-name lists; no live per-issue refresh or compilation.

classification_policy.bug_fix: Clear incorrect existing behavior, regression, existing generic API implementation error, or violation of an existing contract explicitly described in the issue. Eligible only as a defect candidate; dynamic qualification is separate.
classification_policy.feature_or_enhancement: Adds a new type, public API, presentation mode, or capability without clear evidence of a prior supported behavior failing.
classification_policy.mixed_or_unclear: The record combines compatibility/support expansion with an expected-behavior claim whose historical contract is unclear. Excluded from the conservative defect count until reviewed.

inventory_changed_definition: set(run_result.passed_tests) != set(fix_patch_result.passed_tests); this compares recorded passed-name sets, not a complete dynamically discovered CTest inventory. Differences can reflect added targets or changed outcomes. They are adaptation signals, not qualification failures.
test_names_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON object mapping passed/failed/skipped to sorted unique test-name strings; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon). Fixed-test map hashes cover the original entire map. Raw lists/maps remain recoverable from the pinned dataset file; only up to 12 fixed-test names are duplicated here.
counting_notes: These 88 records complement the 41 fmt records. They are upstream issue/PR tasks, not 88 confirmed defects.
A bug_fix semantic judgment is only a candidate label. Require fixed commit/toolchain/test identity, observed baseline F2P, reference F2P/P2P, and independent cold oracle before formal inclusion.
NO_REPOSITORY_RECORD_FOUND means no attempt in the reviewed public repository index, not no model pretraining exposure or guaranteed uncontaminated holdout.
The priority list excludes currently reviewed adapter cases and recorded model attempts, but does not freeze a holdout. Freeze splits and model/budget configuration separately before first use.
A test phase recording NONE can be caused by compilation or discovery failure. Do not infer failing runtime behavior or drop these tasks solely from this metadata.
Reference patches touching documentation/build/new files require explicit scope review. Do not omit necessary changes or silently weaken F2P/P2P to fit a current adapter.
Production paths in test_patch require answer-leakage review; an upstream dataset split is not sufficient evidence of an uncontaminated oracle.
Preparation priorities are static estimates and not measured latency. No new compilation, model call or dynamic qualification was performed for this audit.
